# PAPAFIT

> PAPAFIT is a personal nutrition and habit-building coaching service for busy people and parents in Israel, founded by Alex Kvitnitsky (אלכס קביטניצקי). Coaching runs mainly online, with optional in-person consultations in the Shoham area and central Israel. The site is in Hebrew, with a full Russian version under /ru.

About the founder: Alex Kvitnitsky is a nutrition and habit-building coach, a former professional basketball player and a graduate of the LBS Academy nutrition course. He guides people through weight loss and body-composition change. He is not a fitness trainer.

Approach: a flexible eating framework with no rigid menu and no extreme diets. It includes calorie awareness, protein at every meal, weekly progress tracking by trend rather than single weigh-ins, strength training and sleep, and planning for evenings, weekends and family meals.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +972-52-642-5670, email papafit4u@gmail.com
